patch_description: Reorganizes the complete interaction graph into seven parallel perfect matchings, reducing circuit depth without changing connectivity. One cube matching is replaced by shared CRZ rotations, providing trainable coupling strength. Aggressive sharing ties the input RY and output RX mixers and ties the collective RZ phase to the CRZ entangler, reducing the model from 20 to 14 total parameters while retaining nonlinear phase processing and improving gradient aggregation.
